generalCriterionList.description: A valid copy of KPWD Class IV and above Contractor with validity
Latest copy of the Income Tax return for financial year 2025-26 (Assessment year 2026-27).

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Valid Employees Provident Fund Registration Certificate with recent EPF paid challan
The tender should complete the provisions of the contract labour (Regulation and Abolition Act 1970) and the corresponding Karnataka rules 1974

The intending bidder should have achieved a minimum financial turnover of not less than Amount put to tender i.e. Rs. 9.98 Lakhs in at least two financial years during the last 5 years reckoned back from 2026-27 (turnover during 2021-22 to 2025-26 only will be considered) duly updating the financial turnover at 10% per year to bring it to the price level of financial year in which the tenders are invited per annum upto 2025-26. Audited profit and loss statement (with year wise turnover statement) certified by a practicing Chartered Accountant with Compulsory UID number along with copy of Income Tax returns filed for the two years indicated above shall be furnished.

Liquid Assets and or availability of cridet facilities of not less than Rs. 2.99 Lakhs, (Credit lines/ letters of credit / certificate from banks) for meeting the fund requirements etc., (usavaly the equivalent of the estimated cash flow for 3 months in peak construction period)

Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Tender capacity ( Ax Nx 2.5- B ) where A Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years(2021-22 to 2025-26) (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B Value, at 2025-26 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 1/12 years (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited) Note: The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent.
